sentences.en: Rocks and minerals are useful for us in many ways.
sentences.zh: 岩石和矿物在很多方面对我们都有用。

sentences.en: A rock stuck out from the bank into the river.
sentences.zh: 河岸上突出一块石头伸进了河里。

sentences.en: Rain formed pools in the hollow spaces on the rocks.
sentences.zh: 雨水在岩石的凹陷处形成了水坑。

senses.zh: 岩石岩块，石块；礁；暗礁石头，石子摇滚乐
